# AudioEffectBypass <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AudioEffectBypass:Void effect:Int32, bypass:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | In | Int32 | required | An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `bypass` | In | Int32 | required | `True` turns it off, `False` on. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Turns an effect off and on again without losing its settings. A bypassed echo or reverb takes in nothing new, but what it holds rings out. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* Switching glides over about 5 milliseconds, so it does not click.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
AudioEffectBypass muffle, True  ; in the open
AudioEffectBypass muffle, False ; behind the wall again
```
